The main takeaway from our work is that
ENGOs need to be aware of the science frames that are already in place when they attempt to introduce a new science frame.
ENGOs need to consider the science frames that exist in their target audiences when selecting scientific information for messaging.

the use of scientific messaging to reduce demand for wildlife products in Asia must take into consideration the existing science frames in the region, as well as the institutionalization of a scientific division of opinion.
